name: CEMEX SAB DE CV
share_adj_basis: applied to revenue components only (v5.4); OE/share CAGR enters unadjusted

ads_ratio.source: Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, audited consolidated financial statements, Note 1 Description of Business: each CPO represents two series A shares and one series B share of common stock (3 ordinary shares per CPO), and each ADS represents ten CPOs - 30 ordinary shares per ADS. Corroborated in the same statements, Note 21: 662 million own shares cancelled in 2022 were stated as 22.1 million ADSs (662/22.1 is about 30).
ads_ratio.reason: DATA_GAP:ads_ratio - EDGAR diluted share counts (44,065,652 thousand shares for FY2024, Note 23 Earnings Per Share) are in underlying ordinary shares while the Nasdaq price ($10.25) is per ADS; per-share figures must be scaled x30 ordinary shares per ADS to be comparable to the ADS price.

fx_conversion.source: frankfurter.app — ECB reference rates (closest business day to each period end)

fragility_flags: DATA_GAP:sbc — sbc missing for fiscal year(s) 2022, 2023, 2024 of the last 3 — no tier emitted
STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 22 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency MXN converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion
USD_TRANSLATIONS_USED: the issuer files its own USD convenience translations alongside its reporting currency; the engine used the filed USD figures

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x30.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, audited consolidated financial statements, Note 1 Description of Business: each CPO represents two series A shares and one series B share of common stock (3 ordinary shares per CPO), and each ADS represents ten CPOs - 30 ordinary shares per ADS. Corroborated in the same statements, Note 21: 662 million own shares cancelled in 2022 were stated as 22.1 million ADSs (662/22.1 is about 30).) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already
note: DATA_GAP: required filing data is missing (see data_gap / data_gap_uncovered). v5 never emits a tier on an uncovered data gap — a missing value is not a zero.
